message.content: Based on the discussions provided, LiHua finds several aspects of Black Myth: Wukong immersive. Specifically, she mentions enjoying the exploration aspect, finding it "so fun for me, [and] finding new areas and secrets." Additionally, her comment that "the graphics look insane, and the gameplay seems really fluid" suggests that both the visual aesthetics and gameplay mechanics contribute to the game's immersive quality for her. LiHua also notes that the combat has "unique mechanics that make it fun," indicating that the gameplay itself is an engaging element that keeps her interested in the game.
